overview: A password input built on top of `InputText` that masks the value by default and provides toggle (show/hide) and clear (X) action buttons. The show/hide button switches the underlying input type between `password` and `text`, letting users verify their entry without retyping. Use this component for any password or sensitive credential field; for non-sensitive text use `InputText` instead.

whenToUse: When collecting a password, passphrase, PIN, or other credential that should be masked by default
do: Always pair with a visible label or `aria-label` describing the field (e.g. "Password", "Confirm password")
Use the `error` prop to signal incorrect or invalid credentials after validation
dont: Use this component for non-sensitive text, use `InputText` instead
Pre-fill the field with a real password value - use a placeholder or leave it empty
